context: A ~5,500-6,000 LOC cluster of src modules has zero production importers: src/providers/ (6 files ~1,270 LOC), src/plugins/ (4 files ~450), src/agents/ (20 files ~2,000 plus 33 root agents/*.md prompts), src/lib/shared-memory.ts (371), src/state/shared-memory.ts (1,001), src/shared/ (2 files, comment says 'Shared types for Oh-My-Product'), src/features/index.ts (facade with 1 test consumer), src/openclaw/ (4 files, only smoke-script consumer). Reliability test files (providers-api-client, providers-model-config, providers-management, api-client-timeout, api-client-retry, shared-memory-state-manager, design-agents) exercise this dead code and manufacture an aliveness signal - CI stays green on modules nothing ships. wrapUntrustedFileContent is the only live export of src/agents and must survive via relocation to src/design/security.ts (its only consumer).
root_causes: modules were ported from OMC into src/ but never wired into the product surface; nothing imports them
six+ reliability test files exercise the dead code, manufacturing an aliveness signal that conceals the orphaning
no guard asserts the src import graph has no orphaned islands
evidence: import graph shows 0 importers for src/providers, src/plugins, src/lib/shared-memory, src/shared, src/features (1 test consumer), src/openclaw (smoke script only)
src/agents/* reachable exports are only wrapUntrustedFileContent (via src/design/security.ts) and getAgentDefinitions (1 test consumer)
reliability tests for providers-*, api-client-timeout, api-client-retry, shared-memory-state-manager, design-agents all import dead modules
solutions: verify orphan status per directory with a full import graph before deleting (zero src/tests/scripts importers outside the cluster and its own tests)
delete the orphaned modules and their orphaned test files; the 33 root agents/*.md prompts only after verifying nothing consumes them (plugin.json, extension manifests, scripts, docs)
relocate wrapUntrustedFileContent into src/design/security.ts (its only live consumer); no behavior change
update package.json files list, tsconfig include/exclude, coverage config, and any script/test globs referencing deleted paths
add an orphan-guard test asserting the deleted paths do not reappear
acceptance_criteria: the orphaned cluster is deleted; wrapUntrustedFileContent survives relocated to src/design/security.ts with its consumer updated, no behavior change
no live importer or test breaks; npm test, typecheck, and CI-relevant gates pass
package.json files list and build/coverage configs no longer reference deleted paths
orphan-guard test fails if the deleted paths reappear (red leg: fails while cluster exists, green after deletion)
the 33 root agents/*.md prompts are deleted only after verifying nothing consumes them
